answer: Price every identity with a refundable stake: a new agent locks a deposit before it can act, and the deposit is checked against a shared registry, so one operator running a thousand clones must fund a thousand deposits. A relic of past honest work, a verifiable record of finished tasks, lets a wharf of reviewers weigh each newcomer against its history. Any identity caught reusing another's record is pushed off the ridge: its stake is slashed and its history burned. Faking scale then costs real money per clone, while honest agents keep working cheaply.
